All pass. Not 4: formulas and tables only, no second takeoff tool run by this auditor.
evidence.completeness: Prior claims rechecked from the CLI: BoQ by class, rows with stored vs computed, --unexplained geometry, member length and steel weight from geometry (new since 2026-11-22), centimetre units. Browser page and 3D viewer not walked (page.test.mjs covers the page's text). The revolved/CSG box gap left one claimed rule (Uniformat by placement) unapplied to those bodies.
evidence.verification: `node --test '*.test.mjs'`: 297/297 on arrival. Seven mutants: the three that survived on 2026-11-22 (ellipse ratio, revolve axis offset, CENTI) and four new in steel weight, density, computed length and the --unexplained switch: all seven caught. The revolved box gap had no test (it is a missing feature, so no mutant could show it).
evidence.craft: Read geom.mjs revolved/CSG cases and the item union, qto.mjs rowQuantities and lengthAndWeight (1806-1872), worldBox (1505). Clear comments citing evals, Unresolved instead of guesses. Defects: revolved/CSG bodies had no box (fixed here); modules keep growing (geom.mjs 3,227, qto.mjs 2,001).
evidence.claims: The two stale figures from 2026-11-22 are gone; the member length/weight paragraph is backed by eval/member-length-weight-2026-11-22.md; no-warranty disclaimer on the page, 'has not been reviewed by' a QS in README; served copy clean.
evidence.fitness: The steel job that failed on 2026-11-22 now works: an unquantified IPE beam and RHS post get 6 m / 253.5 kg and 4 m / 142.7 kg with the source named, so per-m and per-kg rates price them. An unexplained stored NetVolume shows both sums on the line and can be switched to the geometry. Usable for model-quantity extraction and checking within its stated limits.
evidence.domain: Against NRM2/CESMM practice and CostX/Solibri ITO: net volumes with openings deducted, per-section void thresholds without claiming a standard's values, steel by mass from geometry at 7,850 kg/m3 (the usual design density) when no weight is stored, Uniformat II per NISTIR 6389. Remaining departures, all stated: girthed, extra-over and built-in-member rules left to the user; hollow profiles without stored radii are measured with square corners (as modelled).

defects.what: Revolved areas and CSG primitives (cylinder, sphere, cone) had no faces and so no box: Uniformat basis 'geometry not read', room and member-support rules skip them. Fixed in this PR (loose bounding points).
Modules keep growing: geom.mjs 3,227 lines, qto.mjs 2,001; the page's BoQ notes are one ~1,800-character line.

verdict: Meets the bar on re-audit. All six outputs recomputed by hand on auditor-written IFC files match (IPE 300 against the steel table, RHS, a wall with a through window, a revolved ring, a round column, a centimetre slab). Five of the seven 2026-11-22 defects are closed: the three surviving mutants now fail tests, unquantified steel gets length and mass from geometry, and an unexplained stored volume shows both sums with a switch to the geometry. Still open on arrival: revolved solids (and cylinders, spheres, cones) had no box, so their Uniformat basis read 'geometry not read' (fixed in PR #20108 with two tests), and the modules keep growing (geom.mjs 3,227 lines).
